confidence_notes: Recent Wollongong cost-of-living aggregates support the meal, coffee, and beer estimates. Cocktail data is sparse; the wine-glass estimate is based on its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic July estimates and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Wollongong-specific aggregate prices. Accommodation is estimated for a mid-sized New South Wales coastal city with Sydney-adjacent demand, allowing for July winter travel.
